title: UMDB: Urban Microbiome Database, release 0.0.0-test
description: Versioned release of UMDB, a rule-screened catalog of public urban microbiome sequencing metadata: 3 runs, 2 BioSamples and 2 BioProjects. Database built 2026-11-20T12:53:23+00:00, eligibility rules 2026.11.6. Includes Parquet tables, the SQLite database, curated collections, the GeoNames reference and documentation. Includes analyses by STRIGA 0.2.0 (https://github.com/aglucaci/STRIGA) run on this exact catalog. Browse it at https://aglucaci.github.io/UMA/.
